possible-duplicate-description: Transaksi yang serupa telah direkodkan baru-baru ini. Sila semak butiran sebelum menyimpan.
auto-transactions-notifications-descript: Transactions can be created automatically based on notifications received on your device.
notification-transactions-description: When a transaction notification arrives, Cashew captures it locally on-device to prefill a transaction for confirmation. Create templates or use supported payment apps.
google-pay-transactions-description: Automatically detect and parse transactions from Google Wallet and Google Pay notifications.
notification-permission-granted-descript: Cashew is listening for incoming transaction notifications.
notification-permission-required-descrip: Cashew needs Notification Access to detect incoming payment alerts. Please enable it in system settings.
notification-privacy-description: All notification parsing occurs entirely on your device with zero cloud data transmission. Under Google Play policies, SMS permissions are restricted to default SMS apps. Android Notification Access provides a secure, privacy-preserving alternative to capture payment alerts locally without accessing your personal text messages.
notification-configuration-missing-descr: Add a template if you wish to parse notifications from other banking apps.
